## ReferenceCountedResourceRelease_005469c0 — Reference-counted resource release with sub-resource cleanup

**Summary:** Decrements reference count at this+0x88; when it reaches zero, iterates sub-resources at this+0xA8 to find matching linked-list nodes (via this+0xB8+0x28), decrements their ref count, destructs per-element data, removes from linked list, and sets this+0x9C flags |= 3. Resource manager reference tracking.

**Frame-path:** NOT_FOUND  
**Call frequency:** UNKNOWN (no static path from tick root)

**Called by:** sub_547710 (00547710), LinkedListWalkWithExitCheck (005487e0)

**Struct fields accessed:**

| Base | Offset | R/W | Init (literal → value) | Purpose |
|------|--------|-----|------------------------|---------|
| *(*(this+0xA8)+0x8C) | 0x0 | R | — | sub-resource struct: ref count field (decremented, freed when 0) |
| *(*(this+0xA8)+0x8C) | 0x4C | R | — | sub-resource struct: element count for per-element destruction |
| *(*(this+0xB8)+0x28) | 0xB8 | R | — | linked list head pointer used for node matching |
| *(this+0xA8) | 0x8C | RW | 0 | sub-resource slot: pointer to sub-array (zeroed after release) |
| *(this+0xB8) | 0x28 | R | — | pointer from linked list head + 0x28 (first node) |
| this | 0x84 | R | — | reference count (decremented each call) |
| this | 0x88 | RW | — | remaining reference count (decremented, checked for zero) |
| this | 0x9C | RW | — | flags byte: bit 2 blocks release if set; ORed with 3 at end |
| this | 0xA4 | R | — | sub-resource count (iteration bound) |
| this | 0xA8 | R | — | sub-resource array base pointer |
| this | 0xB8 | R | — | linked list head pointer |

**Written-by note (persistence):**
- *(this+0xA8) 0x8C: zeroed conditionally when sub-resource ref count reaches 1 and decrements to 0
- this 0x88: decremented each call; persists until ref count reaches zero
- this 0x9C: ORed with 3 at end of successful release (sets bits 0 and 1)

**Globals referenced:**

| Address | Name | R/W | Role |
|---------|------|-----|------|

**Functions called:**

| Address | Name | Purpose |
|---------|------|---------|
| 005478b0 | DoublyLinkedListNodeRemovalWithArrayCleanup | remove node from linked list and free its array allocation |
| 005502c0 | DestructorWithConditionalFreeFlagClear | per-element destructor with conditional free flag |

**Guard conditions (deterministic — field vs literal):**

| Base | Offset | Test | Value | Field / meaning |
|------|--------|------|-------|-----------------|
| *(*(this+0xA8)+0x8C) | 0x4C | > | 0 | sub-array element count: proceed with per-element destruction |
| this | 0xA4 | > | 0 | sub-resource count: proceed with iteration |

**Guard interpretation:** If bit 2 at this+0x9C is SET, BLOCKED: returns -2 immediately (cannot release). If this+0x88 (remaining refs) is nonzero after decrement, returns -2 early (still referenced). Otherwise PASSES: iterates sub-resources; for each matching linked-list node where ref count reaches 0, destructs elements and removes node.
